plain_statement: The edge function of the Heawood graph (14 inputs, 21 edges). Some circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, with at most 25 gates has two different gate wires whose OR (or whose AND) is true at every edge and false at every maximal set of vertices with no edge, and at one of 16 listed pairs of inputs the two wires differ at the first input and exchange their values at the second.
title: A step toward: Search: a circuit of AND and OR gates with at most 26 gates for the edge function of the Heawood graph
